name: Lobed Mirror with Relief Decoration of Rong Qiqi and Confucius and with an Explanatory Inscription
summary: This eight-lobed circular mirror has a relatively narrow, undecorated rim.  The decorative field is wide, circular and lightly sunken.  Two figures appear -- Confucius on left and Rong Qiqi on right --with a hemispherical knob in between.  Below the knob (at the six-o'clock position) is a willow tree.
